name: OWASP Project Catalog
source_notes: Verified against _data/projects.json in github.com/OWASP/owasp.github.io (the data behind owasp.org/projects/), plus ZAP project blog posts.
caveats: Only level 4 = Flagship is confirmed in code (flagships.html selects level 4); the 3.5 = Production, 3 = Lab, 2 = Incubator and -1 = inactive labels are inferred from the 2022 maturity-levels blog and the data values.
Lab (level 3) entries are a selected subset relevant to reinhardt, not the full lab list; incubator projects are mostly omitted.
Item ids are reinhardt-local slugs, not OWASP repo names.
type is null where the notes did not record it; flagship code and tool projects were grouped together in the notes and are recorded as "code".
Summaries are short paraphrases of catalog descriptions or self-explanatory names; summary is null where the notes gave no description, and url is null where the notes did not give one.
